reviewer.role: Independent architectural-clay reviewer; no builder source edits

scope: Holistic offline architectural-clay exact-source review: massing, elevations, roof/crown topology, openings, colors, optical depth, occupied interiors, contacts and evidence cameras

prior_findings_rechecked.status: CLOSED within architectural-clay tier; regression rechecked
prior_findings_rechecked.observation: Fresh top, corner and aerial pixels retain projecting centre bays and reentrant shoulders. Closed terrace roof plates follow each cross-plan tier.
Narrow recessed openings, broad grouped piers, staggered pier heads and cream mezzanine are legible; v005 entrance_access now supplies the formerly missing complete entrance proof.
Heavy gilded buttresses, collars, two-stage tapered cap, four corner pinnacles and four seated diagonal links restore the crown relationships.

Top shows all four diagonal links reaching the octagonal outline; crown_contact and architecture_close show the inner joints meeting solid full-height receiver posts. The saved script derives receivers from the actual face centre and spans z58.85 to64.0, seating them through the lower and upper frame; no formerly exposed air gap remains.

entrance_access includes complete door leaves, pulls/standoffs, threshold, canopy and both bracket bearings with margins. Both bracket feet are on granite piers; the lobby and desk are visible behind the glass.

holistic_assessment: The three exact locked sources were freshly compared with v005. The cream/gold Art Deco identity, dark ground-floor base, cream mezzanine, stepped cross-plan silhouette, narrow vertical openings and octagonal gilded crown remain recognizable at this geometry-only clay tier.

Front, both sides, rear and rear-side show continuous exterior enclosure without a glaring open wall or corner. Top and aerial show complete terrace plates and crown cap. No new floating roof part or pier/contact gap was observed.

Facade detail shows actual recessed reveals, sills, glazing and occupied floor/partition depth. Entrance glazing provides a lobby rather than an empty opaque card; full vertical circulation and a furnished office fit-out are outside what the exterior evidence proves.
Crown receiver and canopy bracket corrections were inspected directly in fresh pixels and checked against the saved authoring script; they were not accepted merely from builder claims.

Whole-building cameras preserve base and crown margins. Detail cameras serve facade, crown and optical-depth inspection. The upward walk view still crops the base, but the dedicated entrance_access view now independently covers the full pedestrian entrance.

The phone board was inspected at original resolution as a comparison aid. Its montage omits entrance_access, so the mandatory individual entrance view supplies that evidence; the board was not substituted for the complete roster.
positive_findings: All four crown links terminate on seated receiver posts, with external pinnacle seats retained.
Canopy bracket feet bear on granite piers, and physical double-door pulls are attached with standoffs.
Cross-plan geometry, narrow fenestration, cream mezzanine and closed roof terraces survive the final corrections.
Exact GLB contains zero images and zero textures: observed surface identity is colored native geometry.
All three sources, all fourteen individual render files and the comparison board were opened at original resolution.

checks.render_source: actual optimized GLB reimport; no geometry/material replacement
checks.render_provenance_basis: Builder report; reviewer inspected pixels and independently parsed exact GLB bytes, did not rerender.

limitations: Architectural-clay tier accepts simplified fine ornament and absent material textures; this is not a textured keeper approval.
Conceptual dimensions are not surveyed. Inferred rear/interior details and complete vertical circulation are not independently established by these exterior views.
The entrance retains a low plinth/threshold step; accessibility or building-code compliance is not certified by this visual review.
Browser and runtime placement/scaling/grounding were not tested by user direction.
The render-to-model relationship follows the saved builder provenance; this independent review did not launch a new render.
Builder pending-review fields were left unchanged; this separate signed-by-agent record supplies the independent decision.
Only external review artifacts were written; builder geometry, source files and prior candidates were preserved.
next_checkpoint: Eligible for exact-hash local architectural-clay registration under the parent workflow. Any textured keeper, browser/runtime activation or publication requires its separate review and authorization.
